howto.name: Upload a MOV clip
howto.text: Drop a .mov file. Short clips work best; GIF has no audio and no real compression.

howto.name: PrivaTools samples frames via FFmpeg
howto.text: Frames are sampled and mapped to a 256-colour palette. GIF has no audio and no real compression.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. Frames are sampled and mapped to a 256-colour palette. Expect the GIF to be considerably larger than the video — use MP4 or WebM if you can, and GIF only where autoplay everywhere matters more than size.

faq.q: How long should the clip be?
faq.a: Short — a few seconds. GIF encodes every frame as an image, so a long MOV becomes a very large GIF. Trim before converting.
No — GIF has no audio track. Convert to MP4 or WebM if you need sound.
For short looping clips in chats, docs, and on the web where autoplaying video isn't supported.
